filename: Revised estimates of CO2 sources and sinks improve global carbon accounting.pdf
title: Global carbon budget rebalanced
testbed_rationale: This is a short News & Views commentary discussing revisions to the Global Carbon Budget; no datasets, benchmark models, or code are produced or provided.
pain_points: Large statistical uncertainties in source and sink flux estimates limit the direct policy utility of the Global Carbon Budget for short-term mitigation tracking
Observational coverage of carbon in the ocean has declined over the past decade
Key satellite remote-sensing platforms tracking atmospheric CO2 may soon go offline
Need to scale from voluntary scientific research assessments to sustained operational monitoring infrastructure
extraction_notes: Nature News & Views article discussing Friedlingstein et al. (2026) (Nature 649, 98-103) and the Global Carbon Budget (GCB). Mention of ML is general ('machine-learning algorithms that extrapolate sparse data to estimate global coverage').
